name: 52 Hertz
source:
Sick and tired of growing older without achieving a single thing, 'you' completely break down after a certain incident and make your way to [Mangyeong-do], a coastal island village notorious as a suicide destination.

Just as you are about to give up on everything and throw yourself into the sea, 'you' unexpectedly cross paths with a 'girl'...

The story of you and her,
beginning in a quiet island village.

Will the two of you ever be able to find happiness again...?

[From [url=https://store.onstove.com/games/2475]Stove[/url]]
translation:
“你”厌倦了随着年龄的增长却一事无成，在某次事件后彻底崩溃，前往以自杀胜地而臭名昭著的沿海岛屿村庄[万庆岛]。

正当你准备放弃一切投海之际，‘你’却意外遇见了‘女孩’……

你和她的故事，
从一个安静的小岛村庄开始。

你们两个还能再次找到幸福吗……？

[来自[url=https://store.onstove.com/games/2475]Stove[/url]]
